spontaneous.spontaneous_reading: The proof closes by isolating the transition index selected by the second saddle, controlling near and far divisor ranges separately, and only then replacing the implicit cutoff by an equivalent explicit one.

directed.source_grounded_mathematics: After inserting the second saddle estimate into I4, the source introduces a transition bound Z of order T and splits residual divisor sums around Z using windows at approximately Z plus or minus sqrt(Z) and a farther range. Partial summation and the divisor summatory asymptotic control the near-transition and tail terms. The cutoff Z is then replaced by an explicit expression differing by O(1), and the estimates for I1-I4 are recombined to complete the theorem.
directed.conceptual_reading: Transition analysis protects the main oscillatory family from the region where saddle and nonstationary estimates meet; the explicit final cutoff is justified only after that boundary layer is controlled.
